content_md: A great phrase from Sam Chua in his talk on Seapunk, **Imaginary Humboldting** as in making an imaginary real ("nature") being the paradigmatic example. The Southbeast Asia exercise from the Khlongs and Subaks workshop in 2025 in Bangkok is a good illustration of how that can work.
